device: Apple Silicon Mac, Safari and Chrome (desktop A and B in the device matrix); tier desktop at 60 fps, keyboard and a gamepad; the staging Worker (tha-bay-web-staging) with the sf world

steps.instruction: Open the staging URL (from the deploy summary of the latest run on main, recorded by AC-7) in Chrome. Pass the age and terms screens and choose New Game. Write the staging URL into notes.json as stagingUrl. Repeat steps 2 to 4 in Safari (note the browser in notes.json for each pass).

With the keyboard play Jump Start (m.a1.01) and Surge Pricing (m.a1.02): WASD to move, F to get into a car, the mouse to look. Both pass; the beats play with subtitles (note in notes.json beats whether each played as the generated clip or the in-engine fallback). Reload the page during Surge Pricing after its first checkpoint toast and choose Continue: the mission resumes at the checkpoint stage with the same cash.

Connect a gamepad (standard mapping). Play Sideshow Sunday (m.a1.03) with the pad: sideshow, raid beat, escape, drive home. It passes; the Racing tile on the Modes page is unlocked and 'coming soon', Fighter and Tycoon are locked, and the unlock toast showed once.

Open the phone: Messages lists a thread per sender with the offer of the next mission (tap it, Jobs opens on that mission). Open the Map app: fast travel is refused while a mission stage runs (the toast says to finish or leave the job) and works to an unlocked district between missions. Write what you saw into notes.json as phone.

Run the story-chase scenario in Chrome: open <preview>/?perf=1&tier=desktop&scenario=story-chase&debug=1 and let it run to its end (60 s). When it ends tap Export and save perf.json and notes.json to docs/device-runs/M05c2/mac/.

Run pnpm perf:verify -- docs/device-runs/M05c2/mac/perf.json --tier desktop --checklist tools/ci/checklists/M05c2-mac.json: median and p95 frame time, frames over 50 ms, render and triangle counts must pass.
